title: VPN not connecting - Gateway not responding
description: Since this morning I cannot connect to the VPN from home. The client shows 'Gateway not responding'. I already restarted the VPN client twice. I have a deadline today and need access to the file shares.

title: Oracle finance database extremely slow, ORA-01013
description: The finance reporting queries on the Oracle database are timing out with ORA-01013: user requested cancel of current operation. About 15 users in finance are affected and the month-end close is blocked.

title: Monitor goes black after Windows update
description: After last night's Windows update my external monitor keeps blacking out for a few seconds every few minutes. I already checked and reseated the cable.

title: Outlook crashes on start, 0xc0000005
description: Outlook closes immediately after opening. Event viewer shows Faulting application name: OUTLOOK.EXE, exception code 0xc0000005. I need to send the client report before end of day.

title: VPN keeps dropping and laptop overheating
description: My VPN disconnects every few minutes and I am losing unsaved work. Also the laptop gets very hot and the fan is loud even when I only have Outlook open.

title: Wi-Fi drops for several people in Building B
description: The Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting on the 2nd floor of Building B. Multiple colleagues on the same floor have the same problem since this morning.

title: New joiner cannot log in to SQL Server, error 18456
description: A new joiner in the analytics team gets 'Login failed for user' with SQL Server error 18456 when connecting to the reporting database from SSMS.
